svg.title: Alumina Refinery
svg.text: Each item stands for the train it belongs to: one digester for six to ten, two flash stages for eight to twelve, one settler and one washer for a six-stage decantation circuit, two precipitators for a tank farm of twelve.
TH-901 and TH-902 are ISO 10628-2 item 8.3 X8031, the gravity separating vessel. The rake is a mechanical internal the standard does not draw.
Soda leaving chemically bound in the residue is replaced by the make-up on S-943. Soda dissolved in the residue's entrained liquor is what the washing on TH-902 recovers.
Lime burning, causticisation, oxalate removal, residue disposal and product cooling are not on this sheet.
